openings.discriminator: Quantity confusion predicts checklist benefit; tray interference predicts local loose materials help without checks. Matched local success with correctly used shared-tray checklists still omitting items defeats the central explanation.
openings.probe: Alternate matched-mixture equal batches: incumbent, shared trays with checks, local loose materials without checks. Independently count contents; tally omissions, crossing reaches and all preparation, filling and checking time. Apply all constraints below; stop within 90 minutes. Subsequently qualify with 60 kits.
openings.uncertainty: O4 mixture is unknown; picking versus filling remains unresolved. Exact quantities must be available from samples; table fit, writing overhead, full-run transfer and depletion remain unverified.

openings.claim: Require the existing assigned-pattern sample during final filling: expose contents beside it, compare specified items, quantities and dimensions, correct discrepancies, then close.

openings.probe: Attempt the actual 60 assigned kits under all constraints below; record comparisons, intercepted errors, total time, shortages and distribution corrections. Stop at 90 minutes; unfinished kits fail.

decision: Both are untested hypotheses from synthetic stipulations. Qualification requires all 60 assignment-matching kits within 90 minutes, at most one distribution correction, exactly two volunteers, specified quantities/dimensions, the existing 180-by-75-centimetre table and existing envelopes/supplies without purchases/equipment. Baseline assembly plus check takes 97 minutes; unopened-stock access and opened-packet area remain unresolved. Small-batch success alone cannot qualify.
